name: crapplet-dcim
description: Crapplet DCIM — datacenter infrastructure management, network monitoring, power and provisioning platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @crapplet/shared && npm run build -w @crapplet/api && npm run build -w @crapplet/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @crapplet/shared && npm run dev -w @crapplet/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @crapplet/shared && npm run test -w @crapplet/api && npm run test -w @crapplet/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @crapplet/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
